When Machines Read Human Text [E · reported_j]

Across 20,000 seeded records in CPython 3.13 on Apple M5 Max (L3 ri_energy_nj), 23 B binary unpack used 280.4 nJ/rec vs 2,212.1 nJ for json.loads (7.89x) and 27,679.2 nJ for tiktoken cl100k_base (98.7x).

1/2 Parse & tokenizer tax (34 workloads, 5 tokenizers):
- 280.4 nJ binary -> 2,212 nJ JSON -> 69,922 nJ C libyaml (249x) -> 575,799 nJ PyYAML (2,054x)
- Compact JSON uses 1.58x & pretty JSON 2.86x CSV tokens
- Node vs Python JSON silently diverge on 2^53+1 integers

2/2 Negative results & WIP limits:
- Base64 (20.3 tok) & Hex (22.7 tok) save ~0 LLM tokens vs CSV (22.9 tok) — binary helps M2M buses, not text prompts
- 109/170 laptop IOReport windows failed >5% idle drift
- CPython WIP (C++/Rust simdjson & wall measured_j open)
